en.title: gr
en.summary: This is the letter L339 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The group gr
paragraphs: The letters gr make the sound /ɡr/. You hear this in the word (green) /ɡriːn/, which means green. This letter group makes only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Release the air with your voice. Then quickly pull your tongue back and curl the tip slightly backward without touching the roof. Keep your vocal cords vibrating throughout the whole sound. Place your hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters gr always make the sound /ɡr/ when they appear together at the start or inside a word. You can hear this in the word (great) /ɡreɪt/. Another example is the word (grow) /ɡroʊ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not roll or tap your tongue against the front roof of your mouth. Never let the tongue tip touch the upper gum. Simply pull the tongue back and keep the sound smooth.
